title: Icy Strait Point

services.name: Whale & Marine Mammals Cruise
services.desc: Your journey begins with a whale-watching cruise from Icy Strait Point, heading toward the nutrient-rich waters of Point Adolphus, renowned for its abundance of humpback whales and other marine life. After returning to shore, you’ll continue by bus through the Tlingit village of Hoonah and into the untamed heart of Chichagof Island, home to one of the highest concentrations of coastal brown bears in the world. As you travel through the lush rainforest and open muskegs of the Spasski River Valley, your guide will point out bald eagles, Sitka black-tailed deer, and the elusive brown bears that roam freely in this remote habitat. Once in the valley, you’ll disembark for a gentle nature walk

services.name: UTV Expedition
services.desc: Your experience begins with a narrated drive through Hoonah-Alaska’s largest Tlingit village-before heading into the forest to gear up and get rolling. After a brief safety orientation, you’ll hop behind the wheel of a rugged TOMCAR off-road vehicle and follow your guide deep into the island’s remote interior. Traverse old logging roads, climb through mountain valleys, and stop at scenic viewpoints for panoramic photos of towering peaks and ocean vistas. Each vehicle is equipped with a two-way radio so your guide can share stories, history, and local insights along the way. services.name: Kayak Adventure
services.desc: Launching from the beach at Icy Strait Point, you and your paddling partner will navigate a two-person wilderness sea kayak with a safety-certified local guide leading the way. Glide past the Hoonah waterfront and into more secluded waters where bald eagles often soar overhead. Keep your senses sharp: humpback whales are known to feed along this very route, offering the possibility of a truly unforgettable encounter. This 2.5-hour tour combines calm-water paddling with the chance to connect deeply with the natural rhythm of Southeast Alaska.
